verdict: No concrete source blocker identified in the four reviewed candidate blobs. Eligible for integration and actual compile/runtime validation; this is not a compiled/tested or acceptance pass.
scope: Bounded same-context independent source review. GitHub connector reads and JavaScript source comparisons only; no compiler, repository script, build, test, host command, child context or source/tree/ref mutation. Only this unreferenced JSON report is created.

candidate_sources.inspection: Full source comparison; exactly six added probe/value modifier lines and no removals. Inspected each actual leaf Text/button modifier sequence.
Full source comparison; complete new recordedButtonText decoder/measurement helper plus exact preservation checks for old helpers and captures.
Entire 290-line source including actual hosted fixture, independent native coordinate observer, public AX traversal and cleanup.

source_preservation_checks.sourceType: Unreferenced candidate blobs, not compiled or run.

source_diffs.ui_changed_behavior: Only the required app-accessibility workflow opts in to the new environment flag. The Save, Cancel and Done child-StaticText queries become explicitly tagged recordedButtonText reads from the owning Button. Save and Cancel are added to the existing height-growth matrix. Original StaticText helper, control/viewport helpers, original captures, keyboard assertions and font/pixel minimum rules remain intact.

checks.evidence: StudioTextLayoutDiagnostics.swift lines 15-20 require DEBUG, -ui-testing and KEYFILL_UI_TEXT_LAYOUT_PROBES exactly equal to 1 for production use. Both View modifiers return self outside that gate; Release also ignores the optional enabled override. ProjectLibraryView passes no override. Across all ten baseline UI source files no flag setter exists; only the candidate app-accessibility workflow adds the setter.
checks.qualification: The optional enabled argument is an explicit internal DEBUG hosted-test seam, so enabled:true can bypass the launch inputs inside native regression fixtures. It is not used by the three production callsites. This is stated rather than describing the override as triple-gated.

checks.evidence: ProjectLibraryView differs by six modifier additions only. Disabled/release modifier branches return self without changing labels, actions, traits, grouping or existing values. Enabled probes add only an accessibility-hidden noninteractive background and an explicitly tagged diagnostic Button value.
checks.qualification: The opted-in diagnostic launch intentionally changes the three Button values; normal-launch and VoiceOver behavior has not been manually executed in this review.

checks.evidence: Done probe is after body-semibold/font and fixedSize, before enclosing HStack expansion/padding; Save probe is after fontWeight/fixedSize and before maxWidth/minHeight/padding; Cancel probe is after body/fixedSize and before 44pt frame. GeometryReader observes the actual Text background in .global space. It does not create a second label, substitute parent bounds, or synthesize a frame from expected font metrics.

Producer and independent UI consumer require the exact DEBUG_UI_TEXT_LAYOUT_V1 prefix, kind recorded-swiftui-text-layout and matching probe identity; decode is bounded to 1024 UTF-8 bytes. Frames must be nonempty, nonnull, noninfinite with finite endpoints. Missing/invalid layout stays pending rather than receiving an expected rectangle.

The UI reader verifies the record is owned by a Button with the expected label, is hittable, has a 44pt target and lies in the real existing viewport. The Text frame must be contained by both the Button and that viewport. Existing scroll-container, foreground-navigation-owner, keyboard/input-assistant and fixed-bar logic is byte-identical. Save and Cancel keep keyboard-present assertions; Done retains its existing fixed-control containment.
checks.qualification: SwiftUI .global versus screen-space AX frames must still align in the actual presented name sheet and library safe-area bar. The native fixture checks an actual host window with independent UIKit conversion but does not itself test those two production presentation contexts.

checks.evidence: Exact comparison proved the original StaticText helper is unchanged, including UIFont line-box and ceil(requiredPixels)/rounded(observedPixels) rule. The new helper applies the same rule to actual recorded Text bounds. All twelve capture names/order per category remain unchanged, giving the original 24 planned captures. All existing 1.25 growth checks remain; Save and Cancel additionally participate.

Preference-key dictionary values are actual CGRect records. The owner assigns @State only when the frame differs, and the resulting accessibility value does not set layout dimensions. No obvious self-sizing cycle, fabricated AX child, Vision/OCR dependency or Swift-5-mode syntax issue was identified by source inspection.
checks.qualification: No compiler was available. Preference propagation, AX value exposure, state convergence and SDK/API/concurrency compatibility remain compile/runtime checks.

candidate_inventory.claim: Prospective source inventory only. The original executed native count remains 134; none of these three new methods has an observed execution result here.

gate_and_codec.checks: Absent switches, each single switch, flag=0, enabled DEBUG combination and disabled Release combination; exact fractional CGRect JSON round trips; wrong probe rejected; zero/null/infinite/pending/untagged inputs rejected.
gate_and_codec.distinction: The two exact round-trip rectangles are codec fixtures; they are not represented as actual hosted layout.

actual_host_geometry.hosting: @MainActor XCTestCase; unwraps a foreground-active UIWindowScene, attaches a UIWindow/UIHostingController, makes it visible, drains the main queue and lays out the real host. Absence of a foreground scene fails via XCTUnwrap.
actual_host_geometry.measurement: Fixture Text('Done') has the actual supplied font and fixedSize. A hidden native UIViewRepresentable background reports UIAccessibility.convertToScreenCoordinates(bounds,in:self) before parent expansion. The separate production probe reports its GeometryReader .global rectangle. The parent label is expanded to 300 by 100 and independently observed as well.
actual_host_geometry.assertions: Default and AXXXL compare real probe versus independent native Text rectangle at physical-pixel coordinates, require containment by the real control, require the control at least 44pt tall and Text smaller than that control, validate the body font/pixel minimum, decode the actual AX diagnostic value to that measured rectangle, require exactly one leaf with label Done, and require >=1.25 height growth.
actual_host_geometry.negative_falsification: The same real hosted Text uses an 8-point font inside the 300x100 control. The parent is asserted to pass the body-size predicate while the actual small Text is asserted to fail it. This directly detects a parent-bounds-as-text false pass rather than injecting a made-up expected geometry.
actual_host_geometry.release_limit: The hosted positive/negative probe exercise is DEBUG-only; Release takes the explicit disabled assertion branch. No Release hosted geometry execution is claimed.

disabled_behavior.actual_comparison: Hosts one baseline action without diagnostic modifiers and another with the modifiers explicitly disabled. Requires no emitted probe frames, baseline accessible-leaf count exactly one, identical actual label/value/traits/isButton records, Done label, Original action value, button trait, and equal independently observed Text geometry.
disabled_behavior.fail_closed_ax: Public accessibility traversal follows actual accessibilityElements/accessibilityElementCount and UIView subviews; deduplicates object identity, skips hidden elements and stops at actual accessible leaves. It bounds visits to 512 and per-container count to 128, throwing on overflow. Missing/empty traversal cannot pass because baseline must have exactly one leaf and subsequent label/value/button assertions also require actual elements.
disabled_behavior.timing_limit: Queue drainage is bounded and no synthetic or fallback AX element is fabricated. An unavailable/delayed public SwiftUI AX hierarchy will fail the regression and must be investigated from actual runtime evidence.

native_regression.cleanup: Each observation hides and detaches its temporary host window in defer. The reviewer did not execute or verify key-window restoration/runtime isolation.

limitations: Source review only; all four objects are unreferenced candidate blobs. No integration tree, Xcode build or test result was reviewed.
No compiler is available; no compile/API success is asserted. Swift 5 mode was considered, but warnings/errors require an actual build.
Actual modal-sheet/safe-area coordinates, first preference delivery, public SwiftUI AX enumeration and dynamic-type text frames must be established by real native/UI execution.
Normal VoiceOver/manual accessibility behavior was not exercised; source no-op gating and an unexecuted hosted regression support the intended preservation only.
The original failed UI job, six failed methods, 15 missing required captures and raw native/UI warm-up failures retain their original outcomes.
disposition: No source-review blocker to root integration was identified. Run and reconcile the actual candidate build, 137 native methods and required UI/image evidence separately; never relabel the original failed receipts.
